account_access.description:
Result of `--check-access` (`not_checked` without it): `available` means the
provider's model metadata is visible to this key. Billing tier, prepaid credit,
and organization verification are not checked.

AccountAccess.description:
Whether a model is visible to the API key, from one free metadata call
(`--check-access`). `available` means only that the provider's model metadata
read succeeded; it does not show that the account can use the model: billing
tier, prepaid credit, and organization verification are not checked, so a paid
request can still be refused.

Artifact.description: A media file saved locally by Iris.

index.description: 0-based position among the outputs of one request/job.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file contents.

CommandName.description: Command identifier: one of the listed commands, or a command a later version of this schema_version adds.

ConstraintView.description:
A rule relating several options or inputs of one request. A request that breaks
it fails with `invalid_argument` and this `id` in `details.constraint`.

CostEstimate.description: A cost estimate. Always an estimate computed from Iris's published price table.

as_of.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the price table was checked.

basis.description: Human-readable basis, e.g. "1 image x $0.011 (gpt-image-1, low, 1024x1024)".

estimated.description: Always `true`: this is an estimate, not a bill.

id.description: Unique within one result, e.g. `credentials.openai` or `access.gemini.<model>`.

DoctorResult.description: `doctor`. The command exits 0 whenever the checks ran; read `healthy`.

healthy.description: False if any check has status `error`.

DownloadState.description: Download state of one output of a succeeded job.

EffectiveDefault.description:
The model a generation command uses when neither `--provider` nor `--model` is
given, honoring the configuration (`image.provider`, the configured default
models).

ErrorBody.description: The error object of a failed command.

retryable.description: Whether running the same command again may succeed; null if unknown.

ErrorCategory.description: Coarse, stable grouping of error codes. Deserialization is tolerant like [`ErrorCode`].

ErrorCode.description: Stable, public error code (docs/json-contract.md): one of the listed codes, or a code a later version of this schema_version adds.

text.description: Text returned by the model alongside images, if any.

mask.description: Whether `--mask` is accepted (its rules are in `mask_requirements`).

mask_requirements.description: Rules a `--mask` must meet; null when masks are not accepted.

max_request_bytes.description:
Largest encoded request (prompt, options, and base64 inputs sent inline) the
provider accepts, if it documents one; Iris checks an upper bound of the size
locally.

JobStatus.description: Normalized status of a persisted provider-native job.

oneOf.description: Record written; submission request in flight (or the process died during it).
The provider may or may not have accepted the paid request. Never auto-resubmitted.
Accepted by the provider and not finished.
Finished successfully; outputs may or may not be downloaded yet.
The provider rejected the submission or reported the job failed.
The remote operation or its outputs are no longer available.

JobView.description: A persisted provider-native job, as shown to users and agents.

remote_expires_at.description:
Earliest time the provider may stop serving the outputs: submission time plus
the provider's documented retention (it may keep them longer). `null` until
the job has succeeded, and when the provider documents no retention.

request.description: Non-secret resolved request options (never the prompt text or input contents).

Lifecycle.description: Lifecycle stage as documented by the provider.

alpha_channel_required.description: The mask needs an alpha channel: its fully transparent areas are edited.

media_types.description: Accepted media types (sniffed from the content).

same_size_as_first_image.description: The mask must have the pixel dimensions of the first `--image`.

constraints.description: Rules relating several options or inputs (empty when there are none).

default_for.description:
Operations for which this model is its provider's default (see
`models.list`): used when its provider is selected without `--model`.

effective_defaults.description:
One entry per operation that has a usable default, in operation order,
independent of the list's filters. An operation missing here has none: a
command for it needs `--provider` or `--model`.

default_for.description:
Operations for which this model is its provider's default: the model used when
its provider is selected without `--model` (the configured
`providers.<provider>.image_model`/`video_model`, else the catalog default).
Several providers each have one; `effective_defaults` says which is used when
no provider is selected either.

OptionValue.description:
A typed, validated option value. Serialized as the JSON string, integer, or
boolean it is.

default.description:
Value in effect when the option is omitted, typed like the option's values
(a string, an integer, or a boolean); null when the provider documents none.

flag.description: Typed CLI flag, or null if only settable with `-O name=value`.

max_chars.description:
Longest accepted value in characters (Unicode scalar values) of a free-text
option; null for other options.

syntax.description: Syntax description for pattern-validated and free-text strings.

async_job.description: True if the real command would create a provider-native async job.

ProviderId.description: Provider identifier: one of the listed providers, or a provider a later version of this schema_version adds.

ResultPayload.description:
Every possible `result` payload. Serialized untagged; the envelope's `command`
tells which variant applies (see the `$defs` in the published schema).

Usage.description: Token/usage information reported by a provider, normalized where possible.

provider_usage.description: Provider usage object as reported (numbers only; unstable shape).

Warning.description: A non-fatal notice attached to a result.

code.description: Stable warning code (docs/json-contract.md): one of the listed codes, or a code a later version of this schema_version adds. Treat a code you do not know as informational text.

description: The single JSON document printed on stdout in `--json` mode.

schema_version.description: Major version of the JSON output contract; this schema describes version 1.

title: Envelope
